title: MITRE T1610 / T1611 Container & Kubernetes Compromise Playbook

steps.activity_name: Validate Runtime Container Escape or K8s API Anomaly Alert
steps.description: Verify privileged pod launch, hostPath mount, exec-into-pod, or suspicious RBAC API call.

steps.activity_name: Inspect Pod Manifest, Image Digest & Mounted ServiceAccount Token
steps.description: Check container image provenance, capabilities (SYS_ADMIN), and cluster-admin bindings.

steps.activity_name: Correlate Host Node Compromise & Cloud Metadata (IMDS) Access
steps.description: Inspect worker node process tree and requests to 169.254.169.254 for node IAM credentials.

steps.activity_name: Cordon/Drain Node, Quarantine Pod & Revoke ServiceAccount Tokens
steps.description: Conditional containment when container breakout or unauthorized cluster control is confirmed.
steps.condition: Triggered when preliminary investigation indicators confirm active compromise or operational impact.

steps.activity_name: Verify Clean Cluster Redeployment & Close Container Incident
steps.description: Document pod security admission enforcement and forensic image preservation.
